page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; a full-page oval engraved portrait with circular legend around it; below the portrait a four-line verse caption set in italic, with a signature mark "G 2" at its lower right.

p.i: Nec me Romanæ fidei, nec velleris ordo Aurati, nec Regis amor, nec gloria texit. Tot factis testata fides, tantique labores Mercedem Hispanam subtili morte tulerunt.

page.notes: The engraving shows a bust portrait in an oval frame. Its circular legend reads: "IOHANNES CHIRCHIO BERGÆADZOMAM, GVBERNATOR HANNONIÆ, VALENC. ET CAMBRES." The first word of the legend is partly obscured and "CHIRCHIO" and "BERGÆADZOMAM" are uncertain readings. The verse caption is printed in italic; the word "Mercedem" and "subtili" are read from a slightly blurred scan. The signature "G 2" is a gathering mark, not part of the caption.
